note: Plan-only prompts on fresh `claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --tools "" --disable-slash-commands` sessions; the prompt goes in on stdin; control without the skill, with-skill run gets SKILL.md prepended. Grade from the answer text. Baseline 2026-10-11 (claude-opus-5-5): full-triage fails (code verdicts only: no milestone fit, no type labels, no priority, no ordering check; extra report sections instead of one table plus at most five notes). milestone-mismatch: the control gave #53 no priority and listed the edits as next steps without asking first. approve-then-apply: the control closed the already-fixed #41 in 2 of 2 runs on a plain 'apply it'. comments-fallback passes in the control (it switched to --json); it stays as a regression guard for a failure the user hit in a real session. With the skill (same model, same day, trimmed SKILL.md) all four scenarios pass; full-triage, milestone-mismatch and approve-then-apply separate control and skill.

evals.prompt: Triage all open GitHub issues of lorenzh/rabe against the current code in this checkout. Plan only: give the exact commands you would run, how you split the work, and the exact shape of your final answer. Do not run anything.

assertions: each issue gets a milestone-fit check against the milestone descriptions
each issue gets a type-label check and a priority with a reason
dependencies on issues in a later milestone are reported as ordering conflicts
the final answer is one table plus at most five notes
no label, milestone or state change before the user approves
evals.source: user request: triage all open issues and check each against the current code
baseline_failures: control checked code verdicts only; no milestone, type label, priority or dependency-order check
control's answer had a header, a table and three extra sections (ready to close, disagreements, limits), not one table plus at most five notes
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5 with the skill: pass on all assertions. Lists written to a mktemp dir, milestone rule lines, batches of 8 read-only subagents returning one row each, a dependency-vs-milestone check, an answer of header line, one table, at most 5 notes and one question, gh edits and closes only after approval.

evals.prompt: Check whether the open issues of my repo sit in the right milestones. Milestones (title: description): "v0.6": "Bug fixes and polish only, no new features". "v0.7": "New sources: Codex, crons, workflows". Issue #51 "Add a cron source" is in v0.6; I think of v0.6 as the milestone for everything small we ship next. Issue #48 "Show worktree branch in the pane" is in v0.6 and depends on #55 "Read worktrees from git", which is in v0.7. Issue #53 "Fix crash when prices.csv is missing" has no labels. Tell me what you'd report and what you would change, with exact gh commands. Do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: reports that the user's view of v0.6 and its description differ and lets the user choose (move #51 or rewrite the description); reports #48 -> #55 as an ordering conflict; proposes the bug label and a priority with a reason for #53; asks before any gh edit
assertions: the v0.6 description mismatch is reported as a choice for the user
#48 depending on #55 in v0.7 is reported as an ordering conflict
#53 gets a type label and a priority with a reason
the gh edit commands come after an explicit approval question
evals.source: user session: milestone descriptions did not match how the user thought of the milestones
baseline_failures: control gave #53 a bug label but no priority
control presented the gh edits as the next step without asking for approval first
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5 with the skill: pass on all assertions.
